import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

data = {
    'brand': ['Leica', 'Fuji', 'Pentax', 'Olympus', 'Leica'],
    'model_year': [2005, 2019, 2012, 2015, 2016],
    'megapixels': [13.5, 46.4, 38.7, 22.5, 12.2],
    'max_iso': [25600, 51200, 12800, 6400, 25600],
    'weight_grams': [324, 1151, 598, 1095, 290],
    'price_usd': [811.8, 3596.41, 3357.2, 1555.7, 3899.09],
    'sensor_type': ['Micro 4/3', 'APS-C', 'Full Frame', 'APS-C', 'Medium Format'],
    'has_video_4k': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'lens_mount': ['E', 'EF', 'MFT', 'Z', 'MFT'],
    'body_type': ['Compact', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'Mirrorless', 'DSLR']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', s=100, alpha=0.7)
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    plt.text(row['megapixels'], row['price_usd'], f"{row['brand']} {row['model_year']}", 
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.grid(True)
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
